questions.stem: The ____ (develop) of science and technology has changed our lives.
questions.explain: the 后、of 前要用名词；develop 加后缀 -ment 变成名词 development（发展）。
questions.verify: 本单元按“构词法与词汇搭配”编写，教材各单元的词汇表未核实；请对照教材核对本单元的重点词汇。

questions.stem: She is always ____ (help) to the new workers in the office.
questions.explain: 系动词 is 后要用形容词作表语；help 加后缀 -ful 变成形容词 helpful（有帮助的）。

questions.stem: It is ____ (possible) to finish such a big project in one day; we need at least a month.
questions.explain: 后半句说至少要一个月，说明一天之内“不可能”完成，要用否定前缀：im- + possible = impossible。以 p、b、m 开头的词多用 im-。

questions.stem: Please read the instructions ____ (careful) before you use the machine.
questions.explain: 修饰动词 read 要用副词；形容词 careful 加 -ly 变成副词 carefully。

questions.stem: The ____ (invent) of the telephone made long-distance communication much easier.
questions.explain: the 后、of 前要用名词；invent 加后缀 -ion 变成 invention（发明）。inventor 是“发明者”，不合句意。
be harmful to 意为“对……有害”；harm 是名词 / 动词，加 -ful 变成形容词。反义词是 harmless（无害的）。
前缀 mis- 表示“错误地”，如 misunderstand（误解）、mistake、misuse。表示“再次”的是 re-，“之前”是 pre-，“不”是 un- / dis- 等。

questions.stem: The new highway will greatly ____ the travel time between the two cities.
questions.explain: will 后要用动词原形；形容词 short 加后缀 -en 变成动词 shorten（缩短）。shortly 是副词，shortage 是名词（短缺）。

lessons.title: 常用动词短语与介词搭配

questions.stem: Please ____ the form and hand it in before Friday.
questions.explain: fill in a form 是“填表”；give in 意为“屈服；上交”，take in 意为“吸收；欺骗”，break in 意为“闯入”。

questions.stem: The meeting has been ____ until next week because the manager is ill.
questions.explain: put off 意为“推迟”；put on 意为“穿上”，put up 意为“举起；张贴”，put out 意为“扑灭”。

questions.stem: I came ____ an old friend of mine in the street yesterday.
questions.explain: come across 意为“偶然遇见”；come about 意为“发生”，come up 意为“被提出；走近”。

questions.stem: She ____ her mother; they both have big eyes and a round face.
questions.explain: take after 意为“（长相、性格）像父母”；look after 意为“照顾”，take over 意为“接管”，look into 意为“调查”。

questions.stem: Our flight was delayed ____ the heavy fog.
questions.explain: 大雾是航班延误的原因，用 because of（由于）；in spite of 表示“尽管”，in case of 表示“万一”。

questions.stem: We must ____ the problem before it gets worse.
questions.explain: deal with a problem 意为“处理问题”；agree with 是“同意某人”，compare with 是“与……比较”。

questions.stem: The town is famous ____ its silk and tea.
questions.explain: be famous for + 特点 / 物产，表示“因……而出名”；be famous as + 身份，表示“作为……而出名”。

questions.stem: Whether we go or not depends ____ the weather.
questions.explain: depend on / upon 意为“取决于；依靠”。主语是 whether 引导的主语从句，谓语用单数 depends。
